description:
About the Role 

 We are seeking an enthusiastic and motivated Python Developer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have foundational experience in Python programming and a passion for building scalable, high-performance applications. You will collaborate with senior developers and cross-functional teams to design, develop, test, and maintain software solutions.

 Responsibilities 

 
 Develop, test, and maintain Python-based applications and scripts.

 Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code following best practices.

 Debug and resolve issues in existing code.

 Collaborate with team members on code reviews, design discussions, and agile development processes.

 Participate in the development of REST APIs, web services, and data processing pipelines.

 Assist in writing unit tests and automated test cases to ensure quality and performance.

 Support the integration of third-party libraries and APIs.

 Maintain version control using Git and follow CI/CD practices.

 Work with Lambda functions for serverless computing tasks.

 Manage and interact with AWS S3 buckets for file storage and retrieval.

 Stay updated with emerging technologies and contribute ideas for improvements. 

 
  

 Qualifications 

 
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

 Experience: +5 years of Python development experience.

 Technical Skills: 

 
 
 
 Proficiency in Python programming.

 Proficiency in web scraping tools (e,g, Playwright, Selenium)

 Familiarity with web frameworks (e.g., Flask, Django) is a plus.

 Basic knowledge of SQL and database concepts (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).

 Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).

 Understanding of REST APIs and JSON.

 Familiarity with AWS services, especially Lambda functions and S3 buckets.

 Understanding of Lambda functions for serverless applications.

 Familiarity with Linux/Unix environments.

 
 
  

 We believe the best ideas and innovation happen when we are together. Employees in this role will work in the office four days, with the flexibility to work remotely one day (Friday). 

  

 Benefits 

 iCapital offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes a total compensation program consisting of competitive salary, annual performance bonus, and equity for all full-time employees; healthcare with 100% employer-paid health and dental insurance; and generous paid time off (PTO).

 For additional information on iCapital Network, please visit https://www.icapitalnetwork.com/about-us   Twitter: @icapitalnetwork | LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/icapital-network-inc
